howItWorksSection.title: Your health, in three
howItWorksSection.description: We design every stage of your visit to make the experience clear, comfortable, and free of surprises.
howItWorksSection.step1Desc: Contact us via WhatsApp or call us. We coordinate the schedule and the specialist that best fits your needs.
howItWorksSection.step2Desc: Find us at Av. del Parque #348, Col. Jardines del Parque. We have parking on site. Open 24 hours.
howItWorksSection.step3Desc: Our certified doctors will evaluate you with the support of our own laboratory and imaging unit for a complete diagnosis.

locationSection.title: Always close

aboutPage.title: Clínica Crystal —
aboutPage.subtitle: We were born with a commitment to offering Aguascalientes and the region a private clinic where medical excellence and human care go hand in hand.
aboutPage.missionText: To provide specialized medical services with the highest quality standards, cutting-edge technology, and a committed human team, to improve the health and well-being of our patients and their families in Aguascalientes.
aboutPage.visionTitle: To become the regional medical reference
aboutPage.visionText: To consolidate ourselves as the most trusted private clinic in Aguascalientes, recognized for the excellence of our doctors, the warmth of our care, and our constant innovation in processes and technology.
aboutPage.facilitiesDesc: Designed so that patients receive diagnosis and treatment without unnecessary transfers.
aboutPage.value1Text: Every patient is treated with warmth and respect, from the first call to discharge.
aboutPage.value2Text: Strict protocols, modern equipment, and certified doctors ensure the best possible care.
aboutPage.value3Text: Our specialists collaborate in a coordinated way for more complete and effective diagnoses.
aboutPage.value4Text: Doctors with high-level training, active professional license, and continuous education.
aboutPage.facility1Text: 3 exclusively for maternity and 2 for general surgery, with cutting-edge technology.
aboutPage.facility2Text: Same-day results, with no need to refer patients elsewhere.
aboutPage.facility3Text: Ultrasound and X-ray available for immediate diagnosis, without leaving the clinic.
aboutPage.facility4Text: On every floor, so patients and families can wait comfortably.
